## Why it matters internationally

Europe's largest solar research institute operates an accredited
measurement chain for the two radiative quantities that govern every
passive surface: solar absorptance and thermal emissivity. Its
integrating-sphere FTIR capability (to 17 µm) and ISO/IEC 17025
accreditation make it a reference for applied, standards-conformant
emissivity characterization of building and energy materials.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** spectral hemispherical reflectance · spectral hemispherical transmittance · solar absorptance · thermal emissivity
- **Spectral range:** 0.3–2.4 µm and 1.9–17 µm (FTIR + integrating spheres)
- **Temperature:** room temperature (spectrophotometric)
- **Methodology:** Spectral hemispherical reflectance and transmittance via spectrophotometer and FTIR with integrating spheres; computes solar absorptance, thermal emissivity, and the Solar Reflectance Index per ASTM E1980; ISO/IEC 17025-accredited façade and solar testing.

**Application domains:** solar façades and building envelopes · functional and selective surfaces · cool surfaces (SRI per ASTM E1980).
